name: Bank of America® Unlimited Cash Rewards Credit Card

localized_names.en: Bank of America® Unlimited Cash Rewards Credit Card

apr.notes: 0% intro APR for the first 15 billing cycles for purchases and qualifying balance transfers; then variable APR applies.

base_rate.description: Unlimited 1.5% cash back on all purchases after the first year

categories.label: All purchases during the first year from account opening

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash rewards can be redeemed for statement credits, deposits to eligible Bank of America checking or savings accounts, Amazon.com purchases, or PayPal checkout.

signup_bonus.description: $200 online cash rewards bonus after making at least $1,000 in purchases in the first 90 days of account opening.

benefits.title: BofA Rewards rewards bonus
benefits.description: Eligible Bank of America customers enrolled in BofA Rewards can earn bonus rewards on eligible credit card purchases.

benefits.title: $0 Liability Guarantee
benefits.description: Bank of America provides a $0 Liability Guarantee for fraudulent transactions.

benefits.title: Balance Connect for overdraft protection
benefits.description: Optional overdraft protection service when the card is linked to an eligible Bank of America checking account; other fees may apply.

benefits.title: Digital wallet support
benefits.description: Card can be added to Apple Pay, Google Pay, or Samsung Pay for in-store and in-app purchases.

notes: Network and tier verified from Bank of America-hosted product card art. Foreign transaction fee and credit requirement were not stated on the official product page scrape.
